buttons.notes: AXP192 PEK input-only central area on the photographed left power actuator near USB-C. The original shared enclosure contains its integral flexure. Board transport short-press/release only; no GPIO, power-off or wake simulation.

housingColorEvidence.notes: Socket plastic color category checked against the exact product source photograph; hex is an approximate display value, not a calibrated optical measurement. Contacts/inner shading independent from shell appearance.

Internal opaque wall behind the connector cluster. Masks the shell-only drawing cutout through the case, while sitting deeper than both connector cavities.
The manufacturer upper end drawing and oblique product photo show an eight-way 2.54 mm pitch female socket. The mouth is level with the end of the case, on the rear side.
Narrower eight square passages give the visible mouths physical depth. The position and depth behind the bezel are inferred from the open tops, not assigned an electrical function.

Estimated carrier below the observed upper socket seat. It supports the socket in the inspection view; the hidden solder joints and printed board layout are unknown.
Opaque backing behind the two native top case recesses visible in the dimension drawing. Exterior geometry and the distinction between opening and housing are preserved.

Thin upper rear backing occupies the open band beneath the photograph-confirmed paper. Its rear face sits flush with the CAD paper deck. The edge follows the adjacent case and visible label contour. The concealed fastening and construction are estimated.
Circular mounting magnet indicated by the manufacturer rear drawing and marked on the annotated product photograph. Hidden depth under the paper is estimated.
Visible brass ring at the manufacturer mounting hole. The modeled ring preserves the opening without assuming hidden thread geometry.
Visible silver screw head and Phillips recess from the rear product photograph. The face sits in the CAD mounting recess. Shaft and thread depth are unknown.

Rear label uses its actual opaque printed shape, independent of the carrier and shell. The calibrated mapping covers about 21.3 by 38.4 mm of the rear face and leaves the four metal fasteners, white socket and unprinted orange case free of paper. The 0.025 mm separation from the supporting rear face controls z-fighting.

textures.notes: Native-resolution decal crop from the official perpendicular back image. XY landmarks use the surrounding 24 × 48 mm housing and the visible paper boundary. Side slopes, brass rings, gray shadows, and white connector are outside this mask.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres
